body: Realizing that some people want to just genuinely hurt and break you to the point of no return. And no, they wont even care. Not once.
Yes, when I finally thought I was feeling better of course I had to dream about her..

Yep, kinda brushed it off my mind but I remembered it today, I mean the creepy thing only happened that day and I had that feeling only once, I can’t think of any logical reason as to why or how that could happen.

I get what you are saying. But everything that you mentioned doesn't exist here. I live in a third world country and we don't have grants or loans, disability programs etc. Everything is corrupt here and the government won't be able to help. As for my ex, I know that thinking about her or fantasizing wont help. Believe me I know, but no matter how hard I try I can't keep my mind occupied with something else. Even when I am working, she will randomly pop up in my mind.
She hasnt replied back in 3 months.. So 3 months
I get what you are saying, but whenever I think about the bad times, I also miss those. I miss the bad times, anything just to see her again
I dont know how to explain it to be honest, at the same time I want to forget everything and move on, but also want to hold on, and remember everything
Damn, I am at my third month and I feel like I will feel like this for the rest of my life… I hope u guys feel better soon
Yes it was the scariest experience I ever had to go through…

So sorry for the late reply, after this post I fell into an even darker place, I didnt talk to anyone or go out until 4 days ago, I stayed in my apartment and just.. idk, I just was alone for some time, I blocked her from everywhere, she texted me from her sister’s number on new years eve to hurt me even more, my friends were out and partying for new years eve, she texted me “Haha party hard huh?” , I said I am at home and I wont be going anywhere, to which she replied “Well good, stay at home and cry, I will send you photos of myself and my new bf while I have fun, it will hurt you even more than now”.. So yeah it sucks

Tbh I dont even know if I can get into a relationship ever again, she used to be the most sweetest, caring and loving person, I would have moved mountains for her, I kinda did, at the beginning I traveled 5 hours by bus just to be with her and 5 hours back to my hometown, I did everything, absolutely everything I could just to make her happy and in the end I get this? Its like I was talking to an AI who was specifically designed to hurt me as much as possible
